# caputchin_troops (Data Source)

All Caputchin troops visible to the caller (own-account troops plus troops where the caller has a membership). Use this for cross-resource lookup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "caputchin_troops" "all" {}

output "shared_troop_ids" {
  value = [for t in data.caputchin_troops.all.troops : t.id if t.kind == "shared"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `troops` (Attributes List) Visible troops. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--troops))

<a id="nestedatt--troops"></a>
### Nested Schema for `troops`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Owning account identifier.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
- `id` (String) Troop identifier.
- `kind` (String) Troop kind (`personal` or `shared`).
- `name` (String) Troop name.
- `tier` (String) Plan tier inherited from the owning account.
